Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp

Class TotpSecondFactorFragment

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp.TotpSecondFactorFragment
All Implemented Interfaces:
SecondFactorFragment
@Component public class TotpSecondFactorFragment extends Object implements SecondFactorFragment
Contributes the TOTP forms to the second-factor page, as every second factor does through the SecondFactorFragment extension point. What the fragment shows depends on the signed-in user:
  • without a confirmed authenticator app but with another confirmed second factor (for example a passkey), nothing: that factor completes the sign-in, so no secret is generated and no enrolment is offered;
  • without any confirmed second factor, the enrolment form: a new secret is generated (replacing any pending one), shown as a QR code and as its otpauth URI, and the first code confirms it;
  • with one, the form of its code and the recovery-code form, plus a warning when 3 or fewer recovery codes are left.
